models_evaluated: MLLM with clinical visual instruction tuning (CVIT)

links.outcome: Accuracy of midline shift captioning on external validation CQ500 dataset
links.effect: BrainGPT achieved accuracy of 0.91 in captioning midline shifts on the external validation CQ500 dataset, alongside internal testing scores.
links.quote: our BrainGPT model scored BLEU-1 = 44.35, BLEU-4 = 20.38, METEOR = 30.13, ROUGE-L = 47.6, and CIDEr-R = 211.77 during internal testing and demonstrated an accuracy of 0.91 in captioning midline shifts on the external validation CQ500 dataset.

unlisted_practices: Clinical visual instruction tuning of multimodal LLMs on 3D brain CT text-scan pairs
Feature-Oriented Radiology Task Evaluation (FORTE) metric for clinical relevance of generated reports
Turing-test evaluation of AI-generated radiology reports by physician evaluators

screen.reason: The study develops and evaluates BrainGPT for 3D brain CT radiology report generation using benchmark metrics, a novel clinical relevance metric (FORTE), and an offline Turing test with 11 physician evaluators.
